response.rationale: The duty to communicate the current revision (SYN-CASE-006-R2) is not yet fulfilled because the patient has only acknowledged the previous revision (SYN-CASE-006-R1), and no acknowledgment of the current revision exists. Clause **S1-11.1.1** mandates clear communication of critical results to the patient, but the acknowledgment requirement is tied to the current revision, not prior ones. The case is **not settled** due to the lack of acknowledgment for the current revision, and no policy gap is exposed beyond the need for acknowledgment of the latest revision.
